name: Soong Mei-ling
contribution: The First Lady of the Republic of China as the wife of Chiang Kai-shek.

checks.lead: Soong Mei-ling  (also spelled Soong May-ling; March 4, 1898 – October 23, 2003), also known as Madame Chiang (Chinese: 蔣夫人), was the First Lady of the Republic of China as the wife of Chiang Kai-shek. The youngest of the Soong sisters, she played a prominent role in Chinese politics and foreign relations in the first half of the 20th century.
